# Pre-implementation Checklist: CI Gate, Ingestion Resilience and Freshness Signal

**Purpose**: requirements-quality review ("unit tests for English") of spec, plan and tasks before implementation. Depth: standard. Audience: reviewer / PR. Focus: (1) traceability and gate decisions, (2) safety and scope of change, (3) test-first order and the drill comparability.
**Created**: 2026-11-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · analysis: [analysis.md](../analysis.md)

**Note**: generated by the `validate-plan` gate. Review Ownership: reviewer-owned; mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied. `[x]` does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the English header of the drill CSV (all nine column names) stated in one place that the baseline file, the script, the lag-reading rule and the report all reference? [Gap, Gate decision 2026-11-20, tasks.md:137]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the baseline README requirement say that only the header line of `metrics.csv` differs from the capture, and give the old → new column mapping? [Gap, tasks.md:152]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the exact sentence of the ADR-0001 `ops` addendum defined, so the test and the ADR task assert the same text? [Gap, Spec §FR-019, tasks.md:111, :121]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the retry reason vocabulary, SQLSTATE classes and log fields defined for every retry outcome (retry, exhausted, recovered)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012, data-model E2a, E3]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the selection rule for the process killed in fault F3 defined as precisely as the simulator selection rule (exact argv, never PID 1, never the helper)? [Gap, tasks.md:153 vs :122]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the quality-gate commands for the "nothing else changed" check (`contracts/`, bronze table definitions, `bronze.py`, `validate.py`, ADRs, CODEOWNERS) listed identically in every phase verification? [Gap, tasks.md:47, :91, :126, :170]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the rule that reads "lag after F2" and "lag after F3" from the baseline CSV specified so that it returns 125 s and 204 s, the figures in the approved spec? [Conflict, Spec §SC-009, tasks.md:158]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "within 15 s plus one healthcheck interval" reconciled with the "15 s + 5 s + probe duration" bound used in the tests? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-008, tasks.md:113]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "exactly one added line" for the ADR reconciled with the blank separator line the plan accepts? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-011, plan.md:124-126]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the meaning of "not computable" (NULL) for every view column defined, with the value a consumer receives? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, data-model E1]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the "safe default" retry window quantified (1 s / 5 s / 120 s) with the 31 s drill outage as the lower bound? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, plan.md:70]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "the CI-ready command unchanged" defined as a literal string that the workflow test compares? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, tasks.md:34]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do plan, research and tasks agree on the number of new settings and where each is read (three in `config.py`, one in `health.py`)? [Conflict, plan.md:185-187, tasks.md:83-84, :119]
- [ ] CHK014 Do plan risk 7 and research R12 agree with the Gate decisions on `SIM_DURATION_S`, the sampling period and the F3 fault? [Conflict, plan.md:286, research.md:417-447, :503]
- [ ] CHK015 Do plan, quickstart and tasks place the `scripts` mount in the same phase? [Conflict, plan.md:266, quickstart.md:154-155, tasks.md:120]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the duplicate treatment (Option A: kept in `bronze.rejections`, excluded from counts and rate, reported separately) identical in spec, plan, data-model, contracts and tasks? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the "no CODEOWNERS entry for `.github/workflows/`" decision reflected in the plan, the research and the verification checks of every phase? [Consistency, research Gate decisions item 2]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the extra `db_recovered` line consistent with "exactly one line per retry" in FR-011 and SC-005? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §SC-005, plan.md:119-121]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Can every success criterion SC-001 to SC-011 be mapped to at least one task and one evidence section of `verification.md`? [Traceability, tasks.md:170]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the ADR "one line" criterion testable in the environment where the gate runs (the `tests` container has no git)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011, tasks.md:111]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the pass condition for the drill before/after table objective for values that do not improve (F3 lag)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the pass condition for the contract job defined for both an invalid fixture and a fixture without a schema? [Acceptance, Spec §FR-003, §SC-003]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are the recovery paths for a database that returns after the retry window, and for a non-retryable database error, specified with an exit status? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, tasks.md:75]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for a line committed just before the connection failed (retry stored as duplicate) and the resulting extra rejection-table row? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, plan.md:283]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the behavior of the healthcheck on an existing database volume without the `ops` schema specified? [Coverage, plan.md risk 5, research R14]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the one-probe flap of `retries: 1` documented as accepted behavior? [Assumption, plan.md:280]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the end of a finite simulator run specified as `unhealthy` by design in the runbook requirement? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, tasks.md:156]

## Non-Functional and Safety Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 Is it specified that verification and live checks never run `down -v` on the developer's default compose project? [Gap, tasks.md:91, :126, quickstart.md:88, :128]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the isolation of the drill (own project name, port guard, outputs only under `drill-out/`, no write to `.drill-input/`) required by a testable statement? [Completeness, tasks.md:147, plan.md risk 12]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the rule that live tests skip unless selected with `-m live` stated for both live tests, so the host suite never stops the database? [Gap, tasks.md:18, :78, :113]
- [ ] CHK031 Are the "no connection string, credential, host, user or event content" rules stated for retry logs, the healthcheck output, tests, docs and the drill raw files? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-021, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK032 Is "needs no repository secrets" verifiable from the workflow file alone? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, tasks.md:34]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the read-only guarantee of the `ops` view stated as a checkable property (views only, no write statement in `006_ops.sql` and `health.py`)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-018, tasks.md:111]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the independence of ingestion from the API, console and `refresh` stated as a testable compose property? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, Principle III]

- [ ] CHK041 Does each phase end with the host suite and the unchanged CI-ready command, with a pass condition on count and coverage? [Completeness, tasks.md:47, :91, :126, :170]
